acceptanceCriteria: A fixture with an unborn test-repository HEAD yields TEST_REPOSITORY_UNRESOLVED (or the spec'd unresolved code), not stale:true.
Credit stays withheld; an existing-HEAD stale case still reports stale:true.
body: Found by the V1-1913 lane while fixing the same class in the worklist (PR #1203; PR #1189 code, V1-1885/1886): witnessReviewValue reports a test repository with no HEAD (unborn branch) as stale:true. Credit is withheld either way, so no false credit, but the reason is wrong: it should say the test repository is unresolved, matching the worklist's SUBJECT_UNVERIFIED reading.
